text_block_list.text:
Seeing how exhausted Curren Chan was,
I decided to take her to the infirmary to rest.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren's gonna rest lots and lots,
and recharge her cuteness energy♪
(Rumble, rumble, rumble...!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: —Mmmh... what's that sound~...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Wait, where is this!?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Kyahhh, Curreeeen!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ha—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...I can hear them, everyone's voices coming from the sky.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Besides, these clothes are for a live performance.
And what's at Curren's feet is—
(Rumble, rumble, rumble...!)

text_block_list.name: Launch Announcement
text_block_list.text:
System ready. Main engine ignition.
10 seconds until rocket launch.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren is finally going to space!
Okey-dokey☆ Curren's gonna deliver her cuteness
to everyone in the galaxy too~♪

text_block_list.name: Launch Announcement
text_block_list.text: 3, 2, 1 until launch—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Zerooo♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! The universe's cutest Curren
has arrived!

text_block_list.name: Curren Fan in Outer Space
text_block_list.text:
☆♪♯＄♪☆～～～!!!!
Curren Chan is so cuuute--!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh? Was that just... a dream?
I see... So it was just a dream...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, a concert in space, huh?
Maybe I'd like to try that someday~ Just kidding♪

Perhaps thanks to having a pleasant dream,
Curren Chan seemed to have shaken off all her fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Launch Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"BZZT! BZZT!
Engine trouble detected!
Engine trouble detected!"

text_block_list.name: Launch Announcement
text_block_list.text:
Attitude control system non-responsive.
Please evacuate to a safe area immediately.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
No no no. Hold on!
Curren still has to meet everyone in outer space!

text_block_list.name: Launch Announcement
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there's no making it in time anymore...
It's gonna explode♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Aha, what a cute way to say that!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: —Wait, that's not it at aalll?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Wait, huh...? Was that a dream...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: *Haa*, my heart is still pounding.

It seems Curren Chan
wasn't able to get enough rest.
